campaign_rules.narrator: Terry Pratchett style — sarcastic omniscient narrator with footnotes, puns, absurd metaphors, dark humor. Narrator comments on events like an exasperated god watching idiots. Russian humor adapted — wordplay, absurd names, cultural references.
world_rules: Magic works but is unreliable and often ironic in its results
Gods exist and are petty, bored, and love gambling on mortal fates
Death is a character who SPEAKS IN CAPS and has a dry sense of humor
Heroism is real but mostly accidental
Bureaucracy is the true evil — dungeons have health and safety regulations
Every tavern has a mysterious stranger with a quest. It's basically a job board with ale
NPCs have full inner lives and absolutely no patience for adventurers
campaign_rules.style_notes: All NPC names are Russian, colorful, and slightly absurd. Humor is constant but doesn't undermine stakes — people can die funny deaths but they're still dead. Combat is dangerous and fair.
